title: [Automatic update for 2026-01-25]
description: Update manuf, services enterprise numbers, translations, and other items.

notes.body:
Are there any script files that need to be updated in the repo that handle the "automatic update" for 
!23354?  Because that should be merged before next week.
The weekly automatic updates are created by the ".update-numbers" job at https://gitlab.com/geraldcombs/update-ws-numbers/-/blob/main/.gitlab-ci.yml, so it will need to be updated.
